title: DIGITIMES Insight: AI agent shopping poised to take off as model providers and merchants seek to break a zero-sum stalemate
description: OpenAI rolled out ChatGPT Wallet in November 2026, allowing ChatGPT Pro and higher-tier subscribers to browse merchants and complete purchases through Dots, ChatGPT's built-in AI agent. The launch comes just months after OpenAI pulled the plug on its earlier Instant Checkout feature in March 2026, underscoring how rapidly the agentic commerce landscape has shifted. While AI agent shopping is gaining significant traction, pushback from merchants shows that its long-term trajectory hinges on whether model providers and retailers can strike a mutually beneficial balance.

title: S. Korea: 550,000 students take college exam amid AI cheating concerns
description: The annual college entrance exam is underway in South Korea Thursday as authorities make all-out efforts to crack down on cheating involving smart devices and artificial intelligence. The College Scholastic Ability Test, one of the nation’s most important academic events, began at 8:40 a.m. at 1,312 test centers across the country and is scheduled to run until 5:45 p.m. A total of 551,864 people have applied for this year’s exam, with authorities deploying some 75,000 proctors and around 8,400 additional personnel to catch cheaters across test centers nationwide.
